title: Bound fixed-paid P104 rank-four and rank-five banks (0% κ change)
body:
## Result and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact #7334 `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`, keep the full paid itinerary and test a productive rank-nine helper split into four and five. The exact signed #7113 caller at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d` is retained. The independently reproduced comparator is κ = 0.00364665195644.

The literal census gives 4,207 representative banks at 90 charts. It reproduces 24 prior exclusions and certifies 2,724 new ones. Two primes agree on 2,049 prefix and 663 suffix exclusions. Two rational methods agree on all 12 selected paired follow-ups. The exact 1,459 remaining banks are listed. The finite-field pairing ranking supplies no rational exclusion.

The complete 17-copy price keeps P fixed and changes T by `T4 +17, T5 +17, T9 −17`. The optimistic one-edit upper is 0.380712103179 raw, below one additional paid rank-one position. Public cochart basis and the fixed endpoint cohort are part of the tested scope.

## Task and replay

Changed scope of `p104-side-correction`, revision 8, on canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The intermediate ranks differ from #7339 and #7353. Use CPython 3.12 from a clean checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-rank-four-five-bank-bound/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-rank-four-five-bank-bound
```

The replay regenerates 19 exact receipts, checks the unresolved key list, and rejects five altered inputs. Registered, committed byte/mode/source-history, navigation and official Git-free checks passed locally. The branch carries the existing #7257 onboarding repair. No candidate reached the physical or outer gates.

## Credit and open question

#7334 supplies the exact word and complete comparator, #7113 the signed caller, #7298 the directed tariff, #7338 the admitted rank stock, and #5599, #7110, #7130, #7339 and #7353 the split and exact support methods. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted. A deterministic exact pairing check of the remaining banks, or a separately priced changed paid route, remains open.
